layout_sources: https://github.com/medovina/ofxstatement-cz-komercni (README: in 2025 KB moved from MojeBanka to KB+ and the CSV changed; the statement CSV comes from "Statements and confirmations" > "Account statement" > CSV) and src/ofxstatement/plugins/komercni.py (cp1250; semicolon; rows above the table keyed "Cislo uctu", "Vypis od", "Vypis do", "Pocatecni zustatek", "Konecny zustatek"; the header row starts "Datum zauctovani" and has the unaccented names Protistrana, Nazev protiuctu, Castka, Mena, Identifikace transakce, Typ transakce, Popis pro me, Zprava pro prijemce; %d.%m.%Y; transaction types with accents such as "Nákup u obchodníka", "Příchozí úhrada", "Výběr hotovosti z bankomatu")
notes: KB+ account statement CSV (2025 format). Windows-1250, semicolon-separated. Labelled rows above the table give the account, the period and the opening and closing balances; then the header, whose column names are written without accents, while the values keep them. Dates DD.MM.YYYY; Castka signed with a comma decimal (no thousands mark assumed); Mena CZK per line. The other columns (Datum provedeni, the symbols) and their order, the quoting, CRLF, any further rows above the table and the oldest-first order are assumed. Expected dates are "Datum zauctovani".
